title: docs(releases): write content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx for the 18.2.0 cut — 221 changesets since 18.1.0, 53 with a BREAKING banner, grouped under the five release-notes headings
body:
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. Maintainer, 2026-10-27, in the director summon chat, verbatim: 「两个暗点：定时 Validate Dependencies 的 OSV 漏洞扫描连续两天红（10-26、10-27），没人读过；content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx 还没写（规则是发版时集中写）。这两个问题创建高优先级卡片。」 Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: the lane that compiles release notes when asked (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15 lists "compiling release notes when asked" as ordinary seat work; `content/docs/releases/**` is release-owned, so this card is the one place a seat may write it). Dedupe: 300 newest open + closed issues, grep `release notes|18-2.mdx|v18/18-2` → 0. **New.** Queued at p1 on the maintainer's word; triage re-grades if it disagrees.

## 维护者速读

18.2.0 的 Version Packages PR #25640 已经生成（版本号 18.2.0），但 `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx` 还没有。18.1 的先例是一页 793 行（`18-1.mdx`），结构固定：Highlights → Release facts, as measured → What's new（需手动处理 / 自动迁移 / 新增能力 / 语义变化 / 其他修复 五段，顺序与 GitHub Release 正文一致）→ New in Console (Studio) → Upgrade checklist。这张卡要在切版**之前**把页写好、挂进 `meta.json`，切版时只改「Release facts」里的提交号和日期。素材是 `.changeset/` 里 18.1.0 之后新增的 221 条（53 条带 BREAKING 横幅），Console 段读 ui 包的 changeset。

## Measured (2026-10-27, `origin/main` `e677770a`)

- `git diff --name-status <@objectstack/cli@18.1.0>..origin/main -- .changeset | grep ^A | wc -l` → **221** new changesets since the 18.1.0 tag (2026-10-24); `grep -il BREAKING` over them → **53**; `check-changeset-no-major` reports no `major` entry (the line stays 18.x per the maintainer: 「后续协议变更的也是 18.x」).
- `content/docs/releases/v18/` holds `index.mdx`, `18-0.mdx` (713 lines), `18-1.mdx` (793 lines) and `meta.json` with pages `["index", "18-1", "18-0"]`. No `18-2.mdx`.
- `18-1.mdx` section skeleton (the precedent to mirror): `## Highlights — 18.1.0` · `## Release facts, as measured` · `## What's new in 18.1.0` with `### The version number is not the signal`, `### Breaking changes you must act on`, `### Converted for you by \`os migrate meta\``, `### New capabilities`, `### Semantic changes`, `### Notable fixes`, `### New in Console (Studio)`, `### Shipped in 18.0.0, listed first in 18.1.0's CHANGELOG` · `## Upgrade checklist`.
- PR #25640 (`chore: version packages`) is open, `mergeable_state: dirty`, head 14 h behind `main`; it is refreshed by the maintainer (Actions → Release → `refresh_version_pr`) at cut time, so the page's "Release facts" are written last.

## Governing text

- `docs/releases-maintenance.md` §3 "Platform layer": the curated page leads with breaking changes + migration, then new capabilities, then notable fixes, with a Console (Studio) section; "Release notes are grouped by what the reader must do" — the five headings 需手动处理 / 自动迁移 / 新增能力 / 语义变化 / 其他修复, in that order, each placed by the changeset's own declarations (`Metadata-protocol:`, the `Clause-②:` arm, the BREAKING banner, the ADR-0087 marker); "Sourcing the Console section": from the `@object-ui/*` and `ui/apps/console` changesets.
- AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails: `content/docs/releases/` is release-owned; written centrally at release time; a code PR never edits it. This card is that central act.
- The §3 "Drift guard" and `scripts/docs-audit` apply: every symbol or route the page names must exist at the version commit.

## Wanted

1. Write `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx` mirroring `18-1.mdx`'s skeleton; add `"18-2"` to `meta.json` after `"index"`; link it from `index.mdx` as 18-1 is.
2. Populate the five headings from the 221 changesets by their declarations (`node scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` prints the grouping the GitHub Release body will use — use the same grouping so the two agree); every breaking entry names what the reader must do and, where an ADR-0087 conversion is `registered`, says `os migrate meta` does it.
3. Console (Studio) section from the ui changesets of the same range (the objectui import #25752 and the `.objectui-sha` retirement are 18.2 facts: the Console now ships from `ui/apps/console` at the release commit).
4. "Release facts, as measured" written with placeholders for the version commit and date, filled at cut; everything else final. Build: `pnpm --filter docs build` (or the docs app's check) green; `check-doc-links` green.

⛔ Not here: editing any other release page; the GitHub Release body (generated at publish); the changesets themselves.

## Acceptance

- The page exists, is listed in `meta.json`, builds, and groups every one of the 221 changesets' entries under the five headings with none dropped (the regrouping script's count equals the page's count).
- A reviewer who reads only this page can perform the 18.2.0 upgrade: each 需手动处理 entry has a concrete instruction.

**Size:** M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

PR #25640 (Version Packages, 18.2.0); #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep anchor); `docs/releases-maintenance.md` §3; `18-1.mdx` (precedent, last touched 05e31a2011).
